'''Deral Thul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Great]] [[House of Thul]] who served as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the war he was stationed on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and at one point in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], he was in the region known as [[Silvan Hills]], along with Imperial forces stationed around a [[Thul Command Bunker]]. Whilst in the bunker he submerged himself fully clothed in his [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Clothing/Legends|robes]] and [[Armor/Legends|armor]], in a tank of [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]], a medicinal liquid.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Whilst Thul was submerged, a Republic-aligned individual enter the bunker and destroyed the control console within as part of an [[Attack on the weather tower|attack]] on the Imperial controlled [[weather tower]] nearby. Witnessing the destruction, Thul broke out of the kolto tank and attacked the individual with his red-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The individual however proved stronger than Thul, and killed him. They then claimed his cybernetic implant and returned it to Republic forces for a reward.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Thul was a Human male, with brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and fair skin. His hair, which was black, was receding by 3643 BBY leaving the Sith partially bald.<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
Thul had experimental cybernetic implants installed within his body and in combat used a red-bladed lightsaber.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deral Thul first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[2011]] by [[BioWare]]. He was the target of the final stage of the "Thwarting House Thul" bonus mission, which Republic players could optionally complete as part of the "Tower Defense" mission. This article assumes that players killed Thul as part of achieving 100% game completion.<ref name="TOR" />
